data.one_liner: Compress videos, remove audio, generate thumbnails in Flutter
data.what_it_does: A lightweight library that compresses videos, optionally removes audio, and creates thumbnails. All output is MP4 with AAC audio for maximum compatibility.
use_when: You need to reduce video size before upload or storage
You want a quick thumbnail for a video file
You need a cross‑platform solution without FFMPEG
avoid_when: You require advanced video editing (trim, merge, filters)
You need a full media player or streaming support
You need to support Android 9 or lower
strengths: Simple API, no extra code generation
weaknesses: No trim or advanced editing features
Cancel compression only on Android (iOS cancel fixed but limited)
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, run pub get, no special permissions required
